_comment: Continuous season text (MV-BS-DES-002). Numbers live in app/js/season.js SAMPLE and are unverified samples. Kiswahili is a draft for native review (Q-044).

scene.en: Stall: {pots} pots, {trays} trays a day, {packs} packs in stock, {papers} unpaid invoices.
scene.sw: Kibanda: sufuria {pots}, trei {trays} kwa siku, pakiti {packs} stoo, ankara {papers} hazijalipwa.

stock.en: {n} packs in stock. One pack makes one tray.
stock.sw: Pakiti {n} stoo. Pakiti moja ni trei moja.

pay.credit.sw: Mkopo wa msambazaji, lipa baada ya wiki 2

blocked.en: Mzee Bakari gives no credit until he is paid.
blocked.sw: Mzee Bakari hatoi mkopo hadi alipwe.

canCook.en: You can cook up to {n} trays a day.
canCook.sw: Unaweza kupika hadi trei {n} kwa siku.

by.hours.sw: Saa za kupika zinaweka kikomo hiki.

ordersNeed.en: Your regular buyers take {n} trays a day.
ordersNeed.sw: Wateja wako wa kawaida wanachukua trei {n} kwa siku.

helper.en: Juma cooks at dawn. Wage {amount} a week.
helper.sw: Juma anapika alfajiri. Mshahara {amount} kwa wiki.

ch.stall.en: Walk-in customers at the bus stand

ch.office.en: Office: chai and mandazi at 10:00, cash
ch.office.sw: Ofisi: chai na mandazi saa 4, taslimu

ch.school.en: School: {n} pieces a day, paid 4 weeks later
ch.school.sw: Shule: vipande {n} kwa siku, malipo baada ya wiki 4

ch.kiosk.en: Kiosk: {n} pieces a day, paid next week
ch.kiosk.sw: Kioski: vipande {n} kwa siku, malipo wiki ijayo

notebook.en: Notebook: customers, dates, deliveries. 2 evening hours a week.
notebook.sw: Daftari: wateja, tarehe, mizigo. Saa 2 za jioni kwa wiki.

unmet.en: Household money not paid so far: {amount}
unmet.sw: Pesa ya nyumbani isiyolipwa hadi sasa: {amount}

loan.en: Loan: {amount} left. Each week {principal} plus {interest} interest.
loan.sw: Mkopo: {amount} umebaki. Kila wiki {principal} pamoja na riba {interest}.

terms.en: Sample terms: repay {principal} a week plus {interest} interest.
terms.sw: Masharti ya mfano: lipa {principal} kwa wiki pamoja na riba {interest}.

closeAsk.en: Close the business for good? Its account stays in your record.
closeAsk.sw: Funga biashara kabisa? Hesabu zake zitabaki kwenye rekodi yako.

closed.en: The business is closed. Its full account stays in your record.
closed.sw: Biashara imefungwa. Hesabu zake zote zinabaki kwenye rekodi yako.

helpNote.en: Using help is noted in your record. It is not a penalty.
helpNote.sw: Msaada unaotumia unaandikwa kwenye rekodi. Si adhabu.

limit.buy.en: Buying: the tin and credit could not pay for all the packs.
limit.buy.sw: Kununua: pesa na mkopo havikutosha kwa pakiti zote.

limit.pots.en: Cooking: your pots were full. Customers left without food.
limit.pots.sw: Kupika: sufuria zilijaa. Wateja waliondoka bila chakula.

limit.hours.en: Cooking: nobody had more hours to cook.
limit.hours.sw: Kupika: hakuna aliyekuwa na saa zaidi za kupika.

limit.plan.en: Cooking: customers wanted more than you planned to cook.
limit.plan.sw: Kupika: wateja walitaka zaidi ya ulichopanga kupika.

limit.demand.en: Selling: food was left over. Fewer people wanted it at this price.
limit.demand.sw: Kuuza: chakula kilibaki. Watu wachache walikitaka kwa bei hii.

limit.collect.en: Collecting: customers owe you more than the tin holds.
limit.collect.sw: Kukusanya: wateja wanadaiwa zaidi ya pesa iliyo kwenye kopo.

limit.none.en: No single stage held the business back last week.
limit.none.sw: Hakuna hatua moja iliyozuia biashara wiki iliyopita.

start.en: Your stall, one pot. Earn a living and meet your promises.
start.sw: Kibanda chako, sufuria moja. Pata riziki na timiza ahadi zako.

goalLine.en: Earn a living and meet your promises.
goalLine.sw: Pata riziki na timiza ahadi zako.

dayLine.en: Day {n}: cooked {made} trays, sold {sold} at the stall, {away} customers turned away, {waste} pieces left over.
dayLine.sw: Siku {n}: trei {made} zimepikwa, {sold} zimeuzwa kibandani, wateja {away} wamekosa, vipande {waste} vimebaki.

note.waste.en: {n} pieces left over and thrown away.

note.invoice.en: {who} owes {amount} for this week, due week {n}.
note.invoice.sw: {who} anadaiwa {amount} kwa wiki hii, inalipwa wiki ya {n}.

note.householdShort.en: The tin could not pay all the household money: {amount} short.
note.householdShort.sw: Kopo halikutosha pesa yote ya nyumbani: pungufu {amount}.

note.blocked.en: Mzee Bakari was not paid on time and stopped credit.
note.blocked.sw: Mzee Bakari hakulipwa kwa wakati akasitisha mkopo.

note.schoolShort.en: The school got less than it ordered.

note.kioskShort.en: The kiosk got less than it ordered.

note.rejected.en: The school did not accept {n} pieces.

note.trial.en: Office trial: on a usual day {paid} of the {invited} people who were interested paid.
note.trial.sw: Jaribio la ofisi: siku ya kawaida watu {paid} kati ya {invited} waliopendezwa walilipa.

cashWarning.en: The tin cannot pay for next week's packs and household money.
cashWarning.sw: Kopo haliwezi kulipia pakiti za wiki ijayo na pesa ya nyumbani.

needs.trays.en: Trays a day with this order: {trays}. You can cook {cap} now.
needs.trays.sw: Trei kwa siku na oda hii: {trays}. Sasa unaweza kupika {cap}.

needs.cash.en: Extra packs, and a wage if you need help, before the first payment: about {amount} over {n} weeks. Your other costs and payments continue.
needs.cash.sw: Pakiti za ziada, na mshahara ukihitaji msaada, kabla ya malipo ya kwanza: karibu {amount} kwa wiki {n}. Gharama na malipo yako mengine yanaendelea.

needs.hours.en: Delivery: {n} of your hours a week.

needs.inspection.en: Food-hygiene inspection {amount}. Sample figure, not a checked local rule.
needs.inspection.sw: Ukaguzi wa usafi wa chakula {amount}. Takwimu ya mfano, si kanuni iliyohakikiwa.

goal.en: Choose a goal. You can change it at any month review. No goal is worth more than another.
goal.sw: Chagua lengo. Unaweza kulibadilisha kila tathmini ya mwezi. Hakuna lengo lenye thamani zaidi.

goal.away.en: A business that runs without you

goalNow.income.en: {a} of 8 full weekly payments; cash equals {b} of 4 household payments before business bills.
goalNow.income.sw: Malipo {a} kati ya 8 ya wiki yametimizwa; pesa ni sawa na malipo {b} kati ya 4 ya nyumbani kabla ya madeni ya biashara.

goalNow.customers.sw: Wateja {a} kati ya 3 wa kibiashara wananunua.

goalNow.away.en: {a} of 1 week with sales while you were away, with the notebook kept and Juma's work checked.
goalNow.away.sw: Wiki {a} kati ya 1 yenye mauzo ukiwa safarini, daftari likitunzwa na kazi ya Juma ikikaguliwa.

f.household.en: Weeks household money paid in full
f.household.sw: Wiki pesa ya nyumbani ililipwa kamili

f.unmet.en: Household money and payments not met
f.unmet.sw: Pesa ya nyumbani na malipo yasiyotimizwa

f.hours.en: Your hours a week, last 4 weeks
f.hours.sw: Saa zako kwa wiki, wiki 4 zilizopita

f.people.en: Helpers hired (unpaid wages appear in debts)
f.people.sw: Wasaidizi walioajiriwa (mishahara isiyolipwa inaonyeshwa kwenye madeni)

limits.en: These are facts from this game, not a score. Sample figures. They do not predict how a real business will do.
limits.sw: Hizi ni taarifa kutoka mchezo huu, si alama. Takwimu za mfano. Hazitabiri biashara halisi itakavyokwenda.

thread.collected.sw: Mauzo ya wiki ya {from}: {who} alilipa {amount} wiki ya {week}.

thread.trial.en: Week {week}: in the office trial {paid} of {invited} people paid on a usual day.
thread.trial.sw: Wiki ya {week}: katika jaribio la ofisi watu {paid} kati ya {invited} walilipa siku ya kawaida.

thread.paymentPaid.en: Week {week}: the household payment of {amount} was paid on time.
thread.paymentPaid.sw: Wiki ya {week}: malipo ya nyumbani {amount} yalilipwa kwa wakati.

thread.paymentLate.en: Week {week}: the household payment due in week {from} was paid late.
thread.paymentLate.sw: Wiki ya {week}: malipo ya nyumbani ya wiki ya {from} yalilipwa kwa kuchelewa.

thread.paymentMissed.en: Week {week}: {amount} of the household payment was not met.
thread.paymentMissed.sw: Wiki ya {week}: {amount} ya malipo ya nyumbani hayakutimizwa.

thread.supplierBlocked.en: Week {week}: a bill to Mzee Bakari from week {from} was unpaid, so he stopped credit.
thread.supplierBlocked.sw: Wiki ya {week}: deni la Mzee Bakari la wiki ya {from} halikulipwa, akasitisha mkopo.

thread.schoolStart.en: Week {week}: the school order began, {pieces} pieces a day.
thread.schoolStart.sw: Wiki ya {week}: oda ya shule ilianza, vipande {pieces} kwa siku.

thread.schoolTrialDone.en: Week {week}: the school paid {amount} for the trial week.
thread.schoolTrialDone.sw: Wiki ya {week}: shule ililipa {amount} kwa wiki ya majaribio.

thread.schoolLost.en: Week {week}: after short deliveries, the school stopped ordering.
thread.schoolLost.sw: Wiki ya {week}: baada ya kupeleka pungufu, shule iliacha kuagiza.

thread.awayCovered.en: Week {week}: the business traded while you were away.
thread.awayCovered.sw: Wiki ya {week}: biashara iliendelea ukiwa safarini.

thread.awayClosed.en: Week {week}: you closed while away and told customers.
thread.awayClosed.sw: Wiki ya {week}: ulifunga ukiwa safarini na uliwaambia wateja.

thread.awayMissed.en: Week {week}: nobody ran the stall while you were away.
thread.awayMissed.sw: Wiki ya {week}: hakuna aliyeendesha kibanda ukiwa safarini.

saved.failed.en: Not saved. Your last step is still on screen.
saved.failed.sw: Haijahifadhiwa. Hatua yako ya mwisho bado iko kwenye skrini.

saved.conflict.en: This run changed in another tab. Reload to continue.
saved.conflict.sw: Mchezo huu umebadilika kwenye kichupo kingine. Pakia upya kuendelea.

unreadable.en: This record does not match this version of the game. It is kept. Download it, or start a new run.
unreadable.sw: Rekodi hii hailingani na toleo hili la mchezo. Imehifadhiwa. Ipakue, au anza mchezo mpya.

offline.no.en: Offline play is not ready yet
offline.no.sw: Kucheza bila intaneti bado hakuko tayari

deleteAsk.en: Delete this run from this phone? This cannot be undone.
deleteAsk.sw: Futa mchezo huu kwenye simu hii? Haiwezi kurudishwa.

newRunAsk.en: Start a new run? This run stays saved. A later run is different evidence, because you know the game.
newRunAsk.sw: Anza mchezo mpya? Huu utabaki. Mchezo wa baadaye ni ushahidi tofauti, kwa sababu unaujua mchezo.

earlierFound.en: An earlier game is saved on this phone. It is kept and you can continue it.
earlierFound.sw: Mchezo wa awali umehifadhiwa kwenye simu hii. Umetunzwa na unaweza kuuendeleza.

offlineFile.sw: Pakua faili la nje ya mtandao

sample.en: Sample figures for testing. They are not checked local prices.
sample.sw: Takwimu za mfano kwa majaribio. Si bei za eneo zilizohakikiwa.

draft.en: The Kiswahili text is a draft for review.
draft.sw: Maandishi ya Kiswahili ni rasimu ya kukaguliwa.

privacy.en: Your record stays on this phone. Nothing is sent.
privacy.sw: Rekodi yako inabaki kwenye simu hii. Hakuna kinachotumwa.

error.en: Could not open the game. Reconnect and reload.
error.sw: Mchezo haujafunguka. Unganisha intaneti na upakie upya.

unsavedLeave.en: This step is not saved. Download your record before leaving. Leave it now?
unsavedLeave.sw: Hatua hii haijahifadhiwa. Pakua rekodi kabla ya kuondoka. Uondoke sasa?

chasePaid.en: {who} paid {amount}. Following up took one hour.

chaseWaiting.en: {who} has not paid. Following up took one hour; the amount is still owed.
chaseWaiting.sw: {who} hajalipa. Ufuatiliaji ulichukua saa moja; deni bado lipo.

recordsTools.en: Records, offline file and earlier games
recordsTools.sw: Rekodi, faili la nje ya mtandao na michezo ya awali

endHelper.en: End future shifts; keep wages owed
endHelper.sw: Sitisha zamu zijazo; deni la mshahara linabaki

history.open.en: See how your business is changing

history.note.en: Compare completed weeks. Your current plan stays in place.
history.note.sw: Linganisha wiki zilizokamilika. Mpango wako wa sasa unabaki kama ulivyo.

trade.unfilled.sw: Mahitaji ya wateja wa kibandani yasiyotimizwa: vipande {n}

history.hours.sw: Saa zako za kazi wiki hii

body.en: This week the household must pay {amount}. The tin has {cash}.
body.sw: Wiki hii nyumbani lazima walipe {amount}. Kopo lina {cash}.

outcome.en: Paid. The tin is lower for next week's packs.
outcome.sw: Imelipwa. Kopo limepungua kwa pakiti za wiki ijayo.

outcome.en: Paid with a loan. Weekly repayments start now.
outcome.sw: Imelipwa kwa mkopo. Marejesho ya kila wiki yanaanza sasa.

outcome.en: Agreed. The payment is now due in 2 weeks.
outcome.sw: Imekubaliwa. Malipo sasa ni baada ya wiki 2.

outcome.en: Part was paid. The rest was not met.
outcome.sw: Sehemu imelipwa. Iliyobaki haikutimizwa.

body.en: The shop has a second pot for {amount}. One pot cooks at most 5 trays a day.
body.sw: Duka lina sufuria ya pili kwa {amount}. Sufuria moja inapika trei 5 kwa siku zaidi.

outcome.en: You have two pots. Raise the trays when you want.
outcome.sw: Una sufuria mbili. Ongeza trei ukitaka.

outcome.en: You can buy a pot from the Cook tile at any time.
outcome.sw: Unaweza kununua sufuria kwenye sehemu ya Pika wakati wowote.

body.en: Your neighbour asks to take 5 mandazi a day and pay next week.
body.sw: Jirani yako anaomba kuchukua mandazi 5 kwa siku na kulipa wiki ijayo.

outcome.en: She takes 5 a day. It is a sale now; the money comes later.
outcome.sw: Anachukua 5 kwa siku. Ni mauzo sasa; pesa itakuja baadaye.

outcome.en: Only cash sales for now.
outcome.sw: Mauzo ya taslimu tu kwa sasa.

body.en: A notebook keeps each customer's amount, date and delivery. It takes 2 evening hours a week. Totals stay on screen either way.
body.sw: Daftari linatunza kiasi, tarehe na mzigo wa kila mteja. Linachukua saa 2 za jioni kwa wiki. Jumla zinabaki kwenye skrini hata hivyo.

outcome.en: From now on, new sales on credit have dates and details.
outcome.sw: Kuanzia sasa, mauzo mapya ya mkopo yana tarehe na maelezo.

outcome.en: You can start it from the Collect tile.
outcome.sw: Unaweza kuanza kwenye sehemu ya Kusanya.

body.en: 20 office workers say: 'We would all buy chai and mandazi at 10:00 every day.' Saying is not paying.
body.sw: Wafanyakazi 20 wa ofisi wanasema: 'Sote tungenunua chai na mandazi saa 4 kila siku.' Kusema si kulipa.

label.en: Buy a flask and cups ({flask}) and start
label.sw: Nunua chupa ya chai na vikombe ({flask}) uanze

outcome.en: The office round starts. It takes 1 hour a day.
outcome.sw: Mzunguko wa ofisi umeanza. Unachukua saa 1 kwa siku.

label.sw: Jaribio la kulipwa kwa wiki moja ({trial})

outcome.en: This week you sell there with a borrowed flask. You will see who pays.
outcome.sw: Wiki hii unauza huko kwa chupa ya kuazima. Utaona nani analipa.

outcome.en: The offer stays open for two weeks.
outcome.sw: Ofa inabaki wazi kwa wiki mbili.

body.en: The office workers still talk about chai at 10:00. This is the last time they ask.
body.sw: Wafanyakazi wa ofisi bado wanazungumzia chai saa 4. Hii ni mara ya mwisho wanauliza.

label.en: Buy a flask and cups ({flask}) and start
label.sw: Nunua chupa ya chai na vikombe ({flask}) uanze

outcome.en: The office round starts.
outcome.sw: Mzunguko wa ofisi umeanza.

label.sw: Jaribio la kulipwa kwa wiki moja ({trial})

outcome.en: This week you sell there. You will see who pays.
outcome.sw: Wiki hii unauza huko. Utaona nani analipa.

outcome.en: You keep to the stall.
outcome.sw: Unabaki na kibanda.

body.en: On a usual trial day {paid} of the 20 people paid. That was one week at one price. Later weeks can differ.
body.sw: Siku ya kawaida ya jaribio watu {paid} kati ya 20 walilipa. Ilikuwa wiki moja kwa bei moja. Wiki zijazo zinaweza kutofautiana.

label.en: Buy a flask ({flask}) and keep going

outcome.en: The office round is now every day.
outcome.sw: Mzunguko wa ofisi sasa ni kila siku.

outcome.en: You tested it and chose the stall.
outcome.sw: Ulijaribu na ukachagua kibanda.

body.en: Baraka and Bi Zawadi heard about Mama Neema. They ask for the same terms.
body.sw: Baraka na Bi Zawadi wamesikia kuhusu Mama Neema. Wanaomba masharti hayo hayo.

outcome.en: Three neighbours now buy on credit.
outcome.sw: Majirani watatu sasa wananunua kwa mkopo.

outcome.en: Only Mama Neema buys on credit.
outcome.sw: Mama Neema pekee ananunua kwa mkopo.

body.en: The office manager told the school about you. The school asks for {full} pieces a day at {price} each, paid 4 weeks after each week's delivery.
body.sw: Meneja wa ofisi aliiambia shule kuhusu wewe. Shule inaomba vipande {full} kwa siku kwa {price} kila kimoja, malipo wiki 4 baada ya mzigo wa kila wiki.

outcome.en: The order starts. Check your trays and cash.
outcome.sw: Oda imeanza. Angalia trei na pesa zako.

outcome.en: The school agreed to the smaller order.
outcome.sw: Shule imekubali oda ndogo.

label.sw: Pendekeza wiki moja ya majaribio ya kulipwa

outcome.en: This week you deliver {small} a day. The school pays at the end of the week.
outcome.sw: Wiki hii unapeleka {small} kwa siku. Shule inalipa mwisho wa wiki.

outcome.en: You declined. That is a normal choice.
outcome.sw: Umekataa. Ni uamuzi wa kawaida.

body.en: The school paid for the trial week. It now asks for a regular order, paid 4 weeks after delivery.
body.sw: Shule imelipa wiki ya majaribio. Sasa inaomba oda ya kawaida, malipo wiki 4 baada ya mzigo.

outcome.en: The order starts.
outcome.sw: Oda imeanza.

outcome.en: The school agreed to the smaller order.
outcome.sw: Shule imekubali oda ndogo.

outcome.en: You declined after the trial.
outcome.sw: Umekataa baada ya majaribio.

title.en: The school says no to a smaller order

body.en: The cook needs {full} pieces a day from one supplier.
body.sw: Mpishi anahitaji vipande {full} kwa siku kutoka kwa msambazaji mmoja.

outcome.en: The order starts.
outcome.sw: Oda imeanza.

outcome.en: You declined.
outcome.sw: Umekataa.

body.en: Another mandazi seller opens near the bus stand. Some customers try her stall.
body.sw: Muuzaji mwingine wa mandazi amefungua karibu na stendi. Wateja wengine wanajaribu kibanda chake.

outcome.en: Your price is now low. Watch your profit per piece.
outcome.sw: Bei yako sasa iko chini. Angalia faida kwa kila kipande.

outcome.en: You keep your price. Fewer people may come for a while.
outcome.sw: Unabaki na bei yako. Watu wachache wanaweza kuja kwa muda.

body.en: The kiosk by the market asks for {pieces} pieces a day at {price}, paid the next week.
body.sw: Kioski karibu na soko kinaomba vipande {pieces} kwa siku kwa {price}, malipo wiki inayofuata.

outcome.en: The kiosk order starts. It takes 3 of your hours a week.
outcome.sw: Oda ya kioski imeanza. Inachukua saa zako 3 kwa wiki.

outcome.en: You declined the kiosk.
outcome.sw: Umekataa kioski.

body.en: Juma offers to cook at dawn for {wage} a week. His name does not tell you what he can do.
body.sw: Juma anajitolea kupika alfajiri kwa {wage} kwa wiki. Jina lake halikuambii anachoweza kufanya.

outcome.en: Juma cooked {skill} of 100 pieces to your standard.
outcome.sw: Juma alipika vipande {skill} kati ya 100 kwa kiwango chako.

outcome.en: Juma starts. You have not seen his work yet.
outcome.sw: Juma ameanza. Bado hujaona kazi yake.

label.en: Hire and train him for a week ({training})

outcome.en: This week he learns. From next week he cooks.
outcome.sw: Wiki hii anajifunza. Kuanzia wiki ijayo anapika.

outcome.en: You keep working alone.
outcome.sw: Unaendelea kufanya kazi peke yako.

title.sw: Baada ya asubuhi ya majaribio ya Juma

body.en: Juma cooked {skill} of 100 pieces to your standard. Training can raise that.
body.sw: Juma alipika vipande {skill} kati ya 100 kwa kiwango chako. Mafunzo yanaweza kuongeza.

outcome.en: Juma starts.
outcome.sw: Juma ameanza.

label.en: Hire and train him for a week ({training})

outcome.en: This week he learns. From next week he cooks.
outcome.sw: Wiki hii anajifunza. Kuanzia wiki ijayo anapika.

outcome.en: You keep working alone.
outcome.sw: Unaendelea kufanya kazi peke yako.

body.en: Last week the school did not accept {n} pieces that were sent.
body.sw: Wiki iliyopita shule haikukubali vipande {n} vilivyotumwa.

outcome.en: You looked into it.
outcome.sw: Umelifuatilia.

label.en: Agree a count for each batch with Juma
label.sw: Kubaliana na Juma kuhesabu kila kundi

outcome.en: Juma counts each batch. It takes 2 of your hours a week.
outcome.sw: Juma anahesabu kila kundi. Inachukua saa zako 2 kwa wiki.

outcome.en: Nothing changes.
outcome.sw: Hakuna kinachobadilika.

body.en: You will be away for five days in week 17. Decide now or next week.
body.sw: Utakuwa safarini siku tano wiki ya 17. Amua sasa au wiki ijayo.

outcome.en: Juma will cook and sell. He can cook less while he also sells.
outcome.sw: Juma atapika na kuuza. Atapika kidogo kwa kuwa pia anauza.

label.en: Close for the week and tell customers
label.sw: Funga wiki hiyo na uwaambie wateja

outcome.en: No sales that week. Customers know.
outcome.sw: Hakuna mauzo wiki hiyo. Wateja wanajua.

outcome.en: You will be asked again next week.
outcome.sw: Utaulizwa tena wiki ijayo.

body.en: Who runs the business in week 17?

outcome.en: Juma will cook and sell.
outcome.sw: Juma atapika na kuuza.

label.en: Close for the week and tell customers
label.sw: Funga wiki hiyo na uwaambie wateja

outcome.en: No sales that week. Customers know.
outcome.sw: Hakuna mauzo wiki hiyo. Wateja wanajua.

outcome.en: Nobody is arranged for week 17.
outcome.sw: Hakuna aliyepangwa kwa wiki ya 17.

body.en: From this week a pack costs {amount}, 25% more. Packs you already hold keep their old cost.
body.sw: Kuanzia wiki hii pakiti inauzwa {amount}, asilimia 25 zaidi. Pakiti ulizonazo zinabaki na bei ya zamani.

outcome.en: Your price is higher. Some customers may buy less.
outcome.sw: Bei yako iko juu. Wateja wengine wanaweza kununua kidogo.

outcome.en: 12 pieces per tray. Some customers notice.
outcome.sw: Vipande 12 kwa trei. Wateja wengine wanaona.

label.en: Ask the school for a better price

outcome.en: You asked the school.
outcome.sw: Umeiomba shule.

outcome.en: Nothing changes. Your margin is smaller.
outcome.sw: Hakuna kinachobadilika. Faida yako kwa kipande ni ndogo.

refused.en: The school said no to the smaller order.

accepted.en: The school agreed to pay {price} a piece.

declined.en: The school kept the old price.
declined.sw: Shule imebaki na bei ya zamani.

found.en: Your delivery notes show {sent} pieces sent last week and {n} not accepted. They show where the difference is, not why.
found.sw: Maandishi yako ya mizigo yanaonyesha vipande {sent} vilitumwa wiki iliyopita na {n} havikukubaliwa. Yanaonyesha tofauti iko wapi, si kwa nini.

unclear.en: Without delivery notes it took 3 hours and the cause is still not clear.
unclear.sw: Bila maandishi ya mizigo ilichukua saa 3 na sababu bado haijulikani.
